items.title: The Fire That Doesn't Go Out
items.hook: A hall that keeps a fire.
items.reveal: Tradition ties it to Kūkai. Treat ‘eternal’ as a living practice, not a physics claim, until checked.
items.notes: Confirm Kūkai / Reikado eternal-fire tradition wording before live.
